_outcome: MARGIN_CF IS NOT SET. n = 16 healthy-window released robot questions against a required minimum of 40, so D168 (4) applies: do not set the margin, report n.
_ordering_kept: D168 (1) requires P_hat to be frozen before any population cell is SCORED. No cell was scored: this is a COUNT of the population, which D168 (4) requires in order to decide whether to proceed at all. No P_hat was applied and no error was computed.

Two cells (reactive, off) have no _rf rerun and never needed one: they were already clean, consistent with the race only affecting long warm-ahead chains. Non-200 non-400 rows: 67 and 29 in the two _rf cells, which are the transport errors with no status the H100 reports, not race 400s.

population_guard_defect_confirmed.found: cf_ontime_frozen.py:91 POPULATION_ARM = 'warm-all-lru', a single arm name, enforced with exactly four cells
population_guard_defect_confirmed.why_it_is_wrong: the four WARMALL_CELLS span THREE arms: warm-all-lru, warm-all-lru-reactive and warm-all-lru-off. The guard as written would refuse two of the four cells it is supposed to admit.
population_guard_defect_confirmed.status: NOT YET FIXED, because fixing it would only enable a margin that D168 (4) forbids setting. It is recorded here so the fix is not forgotten when the population changes.

why_the_population_is_hostile_to_a_healt.mechanism: the two halves of the population fail for OPPOSITE reasons, which is why no reweighting inside it can help. The cells that RELEASE robot questions (warm-all-lru and its kv0.25 cell, 13 and 15 released) are mostly COLLAPSED (6 of 8 and 8 of 9 windows), so their released questions are almost all outside the healthy regime. The cell with the most healthy windows that releases anything (warm-all-lru-off, 12 of 12 healthy) is the NO-WARMING control. And warm-all-lru-reactive has 12 of 12 healthy windows but releases ZERO robot questions, so it contributes nothing.
why_the_population_is_hostile_to_a_healt.predicted: WARMALL_CELLS itself predicted this: 'EXPECT warm-all-lru to push the 62,944-token pool far harder than anything run so far; there is no live number for it. Saturation is a FINDING, not a failed cell.' It saturated.
why_the_population_is_hostile_to_a_healt.consequence: 12 of the 16 healthy-window questions come from the no-warming control arm, so even the n = 16 that exists is dominated by the one arm whose behaviour the margin is least meant to characterise.

what_would_unblock_it: more cells: the margin population is a user-fixed set (D157 (2)), so widening it is a ruling, not a choice I may make
rq30 re-asks in the population cells would multiply robot questions per cell (the rq30 cells carry about 112 re-asks against 20 first asks), but these four cells were run without re-asks

dropping D168 (3)'s healthy-only restriction would give n = 40 exactly, the released total; that restriction exists because D160 (2) says the counterfactual acts only in the healthy regime, so removing it is also a ruling
blocked_downstream: No full-v5 cell may run: D154 (2) forbids any v5 cell before MARGIN_CF is set. V5FULL_CELLS is therefore NOT posted.
